nodes.label: Test the date-arithmetic logic of _rows_to_verify (TTL/staleness detection).
Row with statut='active' and derniere_verification_http older than ttl_days →…
Row with statut='active' and derniere_verification_http within ttl_days → NOT…
Row with statut='active' and missing/empty derniere_verification_http →…
Row with statut='active' and NaT derniere_verification_http → included.
Row with statut='a_verifier' regardless of derniere_verification_http → always…
Row with statut='inactive' → never included (even with stale/missing timestamp).
Integration test: mix of all statuses with various verification timestamps.
